# Version 4.151.2
> **Skia m151 servicing** · Released August 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.102/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.2 refreshes its m151 native baseline without changing managed APIs. The HarfBuzzSharp package uses the m151 revision bucket; its native HarfBuzz version remains 14.2.1.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated m151 servicing baseline** — Incorporates the same-milestone Chrome M151 servicing sync while retaining the existing C API, managed wrappers, and generated bindings. ([#4692](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4692))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
